title: Independent reproduction of methoxy-dependent polarity change in cured-epoxy fragments
difficulty_reasons: The two scientific objects and observables are fixed, but the agent must choose and justify a defensible optimization/property protocol and validate stationary points.
Conformer and method sensitivity must be investigated and bounded without a prescribed software route.
